name: CEPII Network Trade Dataset
notes: Ready-to-use World Trade Network dataset in CSV and Stata formats. Nodes are countries; directed weighted edges are bilateral import/export flows. Includes network-analysis-oriented variables and topology. [220]

name: UN Comtrade Bilateral Trade Network
notes: Network-ready bilateral merchandise trade data. Nodes are reporting and partner economies; directed weighted edges are trade value or quantity, optionally disaggregated by HS/SITC commodity, year, transport mode, and trade flow.

name: CEPII BACI
notes: Research-grade reconciled bilateral trade network derived from UN Comtrade. Nodes are countries; weighted directed edges are harmonized product-level exports. Better suited than raw Comtrade for comparative trade-network modeling.

name: UNCTAD-Eora Global Value Chain Database
notes: Multi-region input-output network linking country-sector nodes through intermediate and final-demand flows. Use for supply-chain exposure, dependency, value-added trade, sanctions spillovers, and geoeconomic network analysis; access conditions vary.

name: OECD Inter-Country Input-Output Tables ICIO
notes: Country-sector input-output network for global value chains. Nodes are country-industry sectors; directed weighted links are intermediate inputs, final demand, value added, and production dependencies.

name: Asian Development Bank Multi-Regional Input-Output Database
notes: Multi-regional input-output network with strong Asian coverage. Useful for country-sector supply-chain dependence, production exposure, trade shocks, industrial policy, and regional economic networks.

name: World Input-Output Database WIOD
notes: Historical world input-output tables linking country-sector nodes through production, intermediate goods, final demand, labor, capital, emissions, and value-added flows.

name: International Monetary Fund Direction of Trade Statistics DOTS
notes: Bilateral country trade network with directed weighted import/export edges. Useful for macro-level dependency, trade concentration, sanctions, supply-chain, and geopolitical bloc analysis.

name: World Bank Global Bilateral Migration Database
notes: Bilateral migrant-stock network. Nodes are origin and destination countries; directed weighted edges represent migrant stocks by origin, destination, sex, age, and historical period where available.

name: UN DESA International Migrant Stock
notes: Global origin-destination migration-stock matrix. Build directed weighted networks by migrant origin, destination, age, sex, and time period; periodic rather than real-time.

name: Global Bilateral Migration Database Özden et al.
notes: Long-run bilateral migration matrix suitable for historical network analysis of diaspora, migration systems, colonial legacies, regional blocs, and demographic ties.

name: World Bank Bilateral Remittance Matrix
notes: Estimated country-to-country remittance network. Nodes are origin and destination economies; directed weighted edges are remittance flows. Model-based estimates should be treated as approximations.

name: UNCTAD Bilateral FDI Statistics
notes: Bilateral foreign direct investment network. Nodes are investor and host economies; directed weighted edges are inward/outward FDI stocks and flows, allowing analysis of investment hubs and offshore pathways.

name: IMF Coordinated Direct Investment Survey CDIS
notes: Official bilateral direct-investment position network. Nodes are reporting and counterpart economies; weighted directed edges record direct investment assets and liabilities.

name: IMF Coordinated Portfolio Investment Survey CPIS
notes: Official portfolio investment network covering cross-border debt and equity holdings. Useful for financial contagion, exposure, offshore centers, sanctions, and systemic-risk studies.

name: Bank for International Settlements Locational Banking Statistics
notes: Cross-border banking network. Nodes are reporting banking systems and counterpart countries; directed weighted edges represent international claims, liabilities, currencies, sectors, and maturity exposures.

name: Bank for International Settlements Consolidated Banking Statistics
notes: Banking-system exposure network showing ultimate-risk and immediate-borrower country relationships. Useful for financial contagion, sovereign exposure, sanctions risk, and geopolitical financial dependencies.

name: OpenSanctions
notes: Entity-resolution dataset linking persons, companies, vessels, organizations, sanctions lists, politically exposed persons, ownership, control, family, affiliation, and identifiers. Requires entity-resolution validation before analytic use.

name: Open Ownership Register
notes: Beneficial ownership and company-control network data from participating jurisdictions. Nodes are companies and persons; edges represent beneficial ownership or control. Coverage is jurisdiction-specific and incomplete.

name: OpenCorporates
notes: Global corporate-register aggregation. Build company-officer-jurisdiction networks from legal-entity records; verify registry provenance and completeness by jurisdiction.

name: Open Supply Hub
notes: Open facility-level supply-chain data. Nodes can include facilities, parent companies, brands, sectors, and locations; edges require joining facility and ownership/brand data.

name: TradeMap International Trade Centre
notes: Bilateral country-product trade network with detailed market-access and partner analysis. Strong for export concentration and product-market network work; some functions require registration.

name: Global Energy Monitor Global Coal Plant Tracker
notes: Facility-level coal infrastructure dataset. Model nodes as plants, companies, parent entities, financiers, ports, grids, and jurisdictions; use for ownership, energy-security, climate, and supply-chain networks.

name: Global Energy Monitor Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker
notes: Facility-level gas pipeline, LNG terminal, processing, storage, power, company, and country data. Suitable for physical energy-flow and ownership network analysis.

name: Global Energy Monitor Global Oil Infrastructure Tracker
notes: Facility-level oil pipelines, refineries, terminals, fields, companies, and country data. Use for energy security, supply chain, sanctions, ownership, and chokepoint network analysis.

name: World Nuclear Industry Status Report Reactor Database
notes: Reactor, operator, vendor, country, status, capacity, construction, and shutdown data. Construct country-company-reactor-vendor networks for nuclear supply-chain analysis.

name: Correlates of War Formal Alliances Dataset
notes: Ready network source for formal inter-state alliance relationships from 1816 onward. Nodes are states; edges are defense pacts, neutrality/non-aggression pacts, ententes, and alliance commitments.

name: Correlates of War Militarized Interstate Disputes MID Dataset
notes: Dyadic and multi-actor interstate dispute data. Nodes are states; edges are militarized disputes with hostility levels, initiator/target roles, outcomes, dates, and dispute characteristics.

name: Correlates of War Intergovernmental Organizations Dataset
notes: Bipartite state-IGO membership network from 1815 onward. Nodes are states and intergovernmental organizations; edges represent membership or participation.

name: Correlates of War Diplomatic Exchange Dataset
notes: Dyadic diplomatic-representation network. Nodes are states; directed ties indicate embassy or legation exchange and diplomatic presence over time.

name: Correlates of War Direct Contiguity Dataset
notes: State adjacency network including land and maritime contiguity. Useful as a baseline graph for conflict diffusion, trade, migration, alliance, and border-security models.

name: International Network Data SPINS
notes: Network-ready international relations datasets including alliances, militarized disputes, intergovernmental organization memberships, trade, and related dyadic network data. [226]

name: Alliance Treaty Obligations and Provisions ATOP
notes: Formal alliance network with treaty provisions, obligations, duration, defense commitments, consultations, military arrangements, and legal detail.

name: Military Alliances Dataset ATOP
notes: Use the consolidated ATOP source rather than duplicate rows; especially strong for alliance design, commitment credibility, treaty clauses, and alliance-network analysis.

name: International Crisis Behavior ICB Dataset
notes: International crisis dataset in which nodes are states and edges or hyperedges capture crisis participation, adversarial relationships, triggers, outcomes, and escalation.

name: UCDP Dyadic Dataset
notes: Actor-dyad data on state-based conflict. Nodes are governments and organized armed groups; directed or undirected conflict edges include incompatibility, fatalities, duration, and location.

name: UCDP External Support Dataset
notes: Network of external support to warring parties. Nodes include external states/actors and conflict parties; edges encode support type such as military, financial, material, intelligence, or sanctuary.

name: ACLED Actor Co-Occurrence Network
notes: Derived network source. Build actor-actor, actor-location, actor-event-type, or actor-time networks from ACLED event records; preserve event IDs and avoid treating co-occurrence as direct alliance.

name: UCDP GED Actor-Location Network
notes: Derived network source. Build actor-location-time or actor-actor conflict graphs from georeferenced organized-violence events; retain original UCDP event identifiers and conflict coding.

name: Global Terrorism Database GTD Perpetrator-Target Network
notes: Derived network source. Build directed perpetrator-target, group-country, group-weapon, group-tactic, or attack-location graphs from GTD incident records; unknown perpetrators require careful handling.

name: SIPRI Arms Transfers Database
notes: Network-ready arms-transfer data. Nodes are supplier and recipient states; directed weighted edges represent major conventional weapons orders and deliveries, with system and year attributes.

name: SIPRI Arms Industry Database
notes: Build company-owner-country-industry networks from arms producers, ownership, arms revenues, employment, and corporate structures. Particularly useful for defense-industrial concentration and cross-border ownership.

name: UN Register of Conventional Arms UNROCA
notes: State-reported imports and exports of major conventional arms. Nodes are reporting states and partners; directed edges are reported transfer flows by weapon category. Underreporting and nonparticipation matter.

name: Conflict Armament Research iTrace
notes: Weapons, ammunition, manufacturer, diversion, transfer-route, armed-group, and supply-chain network data based on field documentation and serial-number tracing.

name: Small Arms Survey Arms Trade and Diversion Networks
notes: Research and source material supporting actor-weapon-route-border network analysis for small arms, ammunition, trafficking, diversion, armed violence, and conflict supply chains.

name: Global Sanctions Database GSDB
notes: Network-ready sender-target sanctions data. Nodes are sender states/organizations and target states; directed weighted edges describe sanctions type, objective, multilateralism, duration, and outcome.

name: TIES Sanctions Dataset
notes: Threats and Imposition of Economic Sanctions dataset. Nodes are senders and targets; directed edges capture sanction threats, imposition, instruments, objectives, costs, and outcomes.

name: OpenSanctions Sanctions Relationship Graph
notes: Network graph linking sanctioned persons, companies, vessels, family, corporate control, state ownership, watchlists, PEP relationships, and identifiers. Validate entity resolution and source recency.

name: GDELT Event Database
notes: Network-ready event stream in which actors, organizations, places, themes, and sources can be represented as nodes; directed edges derive from coded interactions and co-mentions. GDELT monitors global news in over 100 languages. [224]

name: KEDS Kansas Event Data System
notes: Historical machine-coded international event data enabling directed actor-action-target networks. Useful for longitudinal foreign-policy interaction research; archival coverage and codebook awareness are essential.

name: Phoenix Event Data Project
notes: Machine-coded event data producing actor-action-target relationships for political event, conflict, diplomacy, protest, and interaction network analysis.

name: ICEWS Integrated Crisis Early Warning System Event Data
notes: Automated event data supporting actor-action-target network analysis across international and domestic political events; access and versions vary by repository.

name: World Event Interaction Survey WEIS
notes: Historical manually coded interstate events, usable for actor-action-target networks and long-run diplomatic/conflict interaction research.

name: Militarized Interstate Disputes Network SPINS
notes: Network-ready MID data containing state dyads, disputes, hostility scores, onset/termination, roles, and conflict attributes. [226]

name: Intergovernmental Organization Membership Network SPINS
notes: Bipartite state-IGO network data, enabling projection into state-state institutional similarity networks or organization overlap networks. [226]

name: International Trade Network SPINS
notes: Network-formatted historical import/export data, useful for direct country-trade graphs and comparison with alliance, MID, and IGO networks. [226]

name: UN General Assembly Voting Data Voeten
notes: State-vote bipartite network covering UN General Assembly roll-call votes. Project states into voting-similarity networks; retain resolution, issue area, session, abstention, and absence metadata.

name: UN General Assembly Voting Data Erik Voeten
notes: Use one consolidated Voeten UNGA voting entry. Nodes are states and resolutions; edges represent votes, enabling bloc, alignment, polarization, coalition, and foreign-policy network analysis.

name: UN Security Council Voting Dataset
notes: UNSC member-resolution voting and sponsorship network data. Useful for veto, coalition, agenda-setting, permanent-member influence, and diplomatic alignment analysis.

name: UN Digital Library Voting Records
source_type: Global UN voting and document network
notes: Official UN votes, resolutions, speakers, documents, sponsors, committees, and records. Construct state-resolution, state-sponsor, speaker-topic, or committee-document networks.

name: World Treaty Index
notes: Global treaty and agreement database suitable for state-treaty bipartite networks, dyadic legal ties, issue-area clusters, and international institutional mapping.

name: UN Treaty Collection
notes: Official multilateral treaty participation, signatures, ratifications, reservations, declarations, and deposits. Nodes are states and treaties; edges represent legal participation.

name: International Organizations Dataset COW
notes: See COW IGO entry; use for historical state-organization affiliation networks from 1815 onward.

name: UN Peacekeeping Personnel Contributions
notes: Contributor-mission network for UN peace operations. Nodes are countries and missions; directed or bipartite edges represent troop, police, and expert contributions by month.

name: OECD Creditor Reporting System Aid Network
notes: Donor-recipient-sector-project network. Nodes include donor governments, multilateral agencies, recipient states, sectors, channels, and projects; weighted edges represent development and humanitarian finance.

name: AidData Geocoded Research Release
notes: Geocoded project-level development-finance network, including Chinese official finance. Nodes can include financiers, recipient countries, implementing agencies, projects, sectors, locations, and contractors.

name: AidData Global Chinese Development Finance Dataset
notes: Project-level Chinese official-finance network connecting Chinese institutions, recipient governments, projects, sectors, locations, lenders, and financing arrangements.

name: World Bank Debtor Reporting System
notes: Build sovereign debtor-creditor networks from public and publicly guaranteed debt, creditor type, lending terms, debt service, and bilateral/multilateral exposure.

name: Varieties of Democracy Party Linkages Dataset V-Party
notes: Use for party-ideology, transnational party-family, organizational, and linkage networks; primarily attribute-rich rather than a prebuilt edge-list graph.

name: Global Leadership Project
notes: Global leaders, entry/exit, personal attributes, political institutions, and succession data. Construct leader-state-party-family and elite succession networks.

name: Archigos Political Leaders Dataset
notes: Global political leaders and leader transitions since the nineteenth century. Suitable for leader succession, state-leader, conflict-leader, and diplomatic interaction networks.

name: UNHCR Refugee Data Finder Origin-Destination Network
notes: Network-ready forced displacement data. Nodes are origin and asylum/host countries; directed weighted edges represent refugees, asylum seekers, returnees, stateless persons, and other forcibly displaced populations.

name: IOM Displacement Tracking Matrix Flow Monitoring
notes: Origin-transit-destination migration and displacement network data. Nodes include locations, routes, border points, sites, and populations; edges represent observed or surveyed movements.

name: ReliefWeb Humanitarian Organizations Dataset HOD
notes: Network-ready humanitarian organization and response data linking organizations, sectors, countries, crises, clusters, and operations. The Humanitarian Organisations Dataset identifies 2,505 organizations using reproducible criteria. [202]

name: Humanitarian Data Exchange HDX
notes: Meta-platform containing network-relevant humanitarian datasets on organizations, response, locations, aid, displacement, health facilities, roads, markets, boundaries, and crisis operations.

name: Global Fishing Watch
notes: Vessel-port-zone-country network data from AIS and satellite-derived activity. Nodes can be vessels, ports, flag states, operators, fishing grounds, EEZs, and marine protected areas.

name: MarineTraffic AIS Network
notes: Vessel-port-route-country network derived from AIS. Useful for commercial shipping, port-call, maritime chokepoint, sanctions, logistics, and supply-chain analysis; subscription access and AIS limitations apply.

name: UNCTAD Maritime Connectivity Index
notes: Country-level liner shipping connectivity network indicators, ports, maritime transport links, fleet characteristics, shipping connectivity, and trade logistics.

name: OpenSky Network
notes: Open ADS-B flight data enabling airport-airport, airline-route, aircraft-operator, airspace, military aviation, and movement network analysis; coverage varies geographically.

name: OurAirports
notes: Open global airport, runway, frequency, country, and location data. Join with OpenSky or commercial flight feeds to create route and infrastructure networks.

name: OONI Measurement Network
notes: Network-measurement data linking countries, autonomous systems, ISPs, domains, apps, protocols, and censorship observations. Suitable for infrastructure and information-control networks.

name: CAIDA AS Relationships Dataset
notes: Global autonomous-system topology and inferred business relationship graph. Nodes are ASNs; edges represent provider-customer or peer-peer relationships, enabling internet infrastructure and dependency analysis.

name: CAIDA AS Rank
notes: Global autonomous-system relationship and ranking data, including customer cones, topology, country links, and internet centrality indicators.

name: RIPE Atlas
notes: Global distributed probe and anchor measurements of routing, latency, DNS, connectivity, reachability, internet outages, and network paths.

name: RIPEstat
notes: Network data on IP prefixes, ASNs, BGP routing, internet registry resources, geographic allocation, routing history, and connectivity relationships.

name: PeeringDB
notes: Community-maintained data on networks, IXPs, facilities, ports, peering policies, and internet interconnection infrastructure; verify self-reported entries.

name: Wikidata Knowledge Graph
notes: Open knowledge graph linking people, companies, places, organizations, events, offices, works, identifiers, and relationships. Useful for entity enrichment, not standalone confirmation.

name: OpenAlex Scholarly Graph
notes: Graph-ready scholarly data linking works, authors, institutions, concepts, funders, countries, citations, and research outputs; useful for innovation and science-network analysis.

name: GitHub Archive
notes: Public GitHub event archive for developer-repository-organization collaboration networks, open-source project ecosystems, technology diffusion, and software supply-chain research.

name: Software Heritage Graph Dataset
notes: Graph of source-code origins, commits, directories, files, releases, repositories, and provenance relationships; technically demanding but valuable for software dependency research.

name: Bellingcat Investigation Graphs
notes: Investigation-specific networks linking actors, locations, organizations, companies, equipment, documents, social-media evidence, and events. Usually published as case-specific evidence, not one unified downloadable graph.

name: Forensic Architecture Investigative Cases
notes: Case-specific evidence networks linking locations, actors, visual material, satellite imagery, documents, timelines, structures, and incidents. Useful as reproducible networked evidence rather than a standardized global edge list.

name: OpenStreetMap
notes: Network-ready roads, paths, railways, waterways, buildings, infrastructure, boundaries, and geographic features. Build transportation, logistics, urban, and infrastructure graphs; local completeness varies.

name: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team HOT
notes: Humanitarian road, building, facility, settlement, and access-network data, often generated for crises and resilience work; combine with population, hazard, and response datasets.

name: World Development Indicators
notes: World Bank’s principal cross-country development dataset, covering population, poverty, health, education, economy, trade, finance, infrastructure, environment, governance-related indicators, and development outcomes.

name: World Bank Global Economic Monitor
notes: High-frequency global macroeconomic indicators including inflation, exchange rates, industrial production, trade, commodities, financial markets, and national economic performance.

name: World Bank International Debt Statistics
notes: Cross-country external debt stocks, flows, debt-service obligations, creditor composition, financing terms, and public/private debt indicators.

name: World Bank Global Financial Development Database
notes: Cross-country indicators of financial access, depth, efficiency, stability, banking, capital markets, institutions, and financial-sector development.

name: World Bank Enterprise Surveys
notes: Firm-level survey data on business constraints, corruption, finance, labor, trade, technology, regulation, gender, and enterprise performance across economies.

name: World Bank Worldwide Governance Indicators
notes: Cross-country composite indicators for voice and accountability, political stability, government effectiveness, regulatory quality, rule of law, and control of corruption; model-based and best used alongside component evidence.

name: World Bank Logistics Performance Index
notes: Periodic comparative measure of customs, infrastructure, logistics competence, shipment tracking, timeliness, and trade logistics performance.

name: World Bank Global Findex
notes: Survey dataset on account ownership, savings, borrowing, mobile money, payments, resilience, financial access, and financial inclusion.

name: IMF International Financial Statistics
notes: Cross-country monetary, exchange-rate, balance-of-payments, banking, financial, price, fiscal, and macroeconomic time series.

name: IMF Direction of Trade Statistics
notes: Bilateral merchandise trade matrix, providing partner-country exports, imports, and trade trends using IMF-reconciled country reports.

name: IMF Coordinated Portfolio Investment Survey
notes: Cross-border portfolio investment positions, issuer and investor geography, debt/equity holdings, and international financial exposure.

name: IMF Coordinated Direct Investment Survey
notes: Cross-country inward and outward direct-investment positions, counterpart economies, ownership relationships, and global FDI patterns.

name: IMF World Economic Outlook Database
notes: IMF historical estimates and projections for GDP, inflation, unemployment, fiscal balances, current accounts, debt, trade, and macroeconomic conditions.

name: IMF Fiscal Monitor Database
notes: Cross-country public finance, debt, deficit, revenue, expenditure, fiscal-risk, and medium-term fiscal projection data.

name: OECD Data Explorer
notes: High-quality comparative data on advanced and partner economies, including productivity, trade, labor, education, tax, finance, innovation, governance, and social policy.

name: OECD Creditor Reporting System CRS
source_type: Global aid and development finance dataset
notes: Detailed bilateral and multilateral official development assistance, project finance, humanitarian aid, sector allocations, donors, recipients, and aid channels.

name: UN Comtrade
notes: Official national customs and trade data by reporter, partner, commodity code, quantity, value, transport, and period; indispensable for trade and sanctions work.

name: UNCTADstat
source_type: Global trade investment and development dataset
notes: Global data on trade, FDI, commodities, digital economy, maritime transport, debt, development, productive capacity, and global value chains.

name: UNCTAD Global Trade Update and Data Hub
notes: Near-term global trade indicators, bilateral and sectoral trade analysis, commodity trends, shipping, investment, and geoeconomic monitoring.

name: UNIDO Industrial Statistics Database
notes: Cross-country manufacturing, industrial production, value added, employment, energy, sector, and industrial-development data.

name: FAOSTAT
notes: Global agriculture, land use, crops, livestock, fisheries, food balances, fertilizer, emissions, prices, trade, forests, and food security data.

name: World Food Programme HungerMap LIVE
notes: Near-real-time food insecurity, conflict, economic shocks, weather, market prices, displacement, and crisis indicators for humanitarian early warning.

name: International Energy Agency Data Explorer
notes: High-value energy supply, demand, electricity, oil, gas, coal, renewables, emissions, prices, infrastructure, and energy-security data; some products are paywalled.

name: Energy Institute Statistical Review of World Energy
notes: Open annual global energy data covering oil, gas, coal, power, renewables, nuclear, emissions, reserves, production, consumption, and trade.

name: UN Energy Global SDG7 Database
notes: Cross-country electricity access, clean cooking, renewable energy, energy efficiency, energy finance, and SDG7 progress data.

name: International Labour Organization ILOSTAT
notes: Global labor force, employment, unemployment, wages, working time, gender, migration, social protection, labor rights, and occupational data.

name: UNESCO Institute for Statistics UIS
source_type: Global education science and culture dataset
notes: Global education, literacy, research, science, culture, ICT in education, teachers, enrollment, spending, and learning indicators.

name: International Telecommunication Union ICT DataHub
notes: Global indicators on internet use, mobile subscriptions, broadband, affordability, digital access, ICT infrastructure, and connectivity.

name: International Renewable Energy Agency IRENASTAT
notes: Global renewable capacity, generation, investment, jobs, technology cost, renewable-resource, green-hydrogen, and energy-transition data.

name: Global Trade Alert
notes: Near-real-time monitoring of trade-distorting policies, subsidies, tariffs, export controls, investment measures, sanctions-related trade actions, and industrial policy.

name: CEPII Gravity Database
notes: Standard global bilateral dataset for trade, distance, borders, language, colonial ties, currency unions, institutions, and gravity-model analysis.

name: Penn World Table
notes: Cross-country purchasing-power-parity, output, capital, productivity, labor, expenditure, and comparative development data.

name: Maddison Project Database
notes: Long-run historical estimates of population, GDP, GDP per capita, comparative development, and economic growth.

name: World Inequality Database WID.world
notes: Global income, wealth, tax, distributional national-account, inequality, ownership, and historical fiscal data.

name: Global Wealth Databook UBS
notes: Cross-country household wealth, assets, debt, millionaires, wealth distribution, and financial-asset estimates; methodology is proprietary but documented.

name: V-Dem Dataset
notes: Extensive expert-coded dataset on democracy, autocratization, elections, civil society, media, judicial independence, corruption, rights, political parties, and institutional change.

name: Freedom House Freedom in the World
notes: Annual country ratings and reports on political rights, civil liberties, democracy, repression, media, rule of law, and civic space; normative framework should be explicit.

name: Bertelsmann Transformation Index BTI
notes: Comparative expert assessments of political transformation, governance, market economy, rule of law, democracy, state capacity, and reform.

name: International IDEA Global State of Democracy Indices
notes: Comparative indicators and country profiles on representation, rights, rule of law, participation, institutions, social rights, democratic erosion, and political trends.

name: Varieties of Party Identity and Organization V-Party
notes: Global expert-coded data on party ideology, organization, linkages, polarization, populism, and political-party characteristics.

name: Database of Political Institutions DPI
notes: Cross-country political institutions, election systems, parties, checks and balances, executive and legislative characteristics, and government composition.

name: Quality of Government Standard Dataset
notes: Integrated cross-national dataset combining political institutions, corruption, democracy, public administration, social policy, development, and historical variables.

name: Comparative Constitutions Project
notes: Structured constitutional text and coding for rights, executive power, courts, elections, security, emergency rules, federalism, and institutional design.

name: Global Elections Database
notes: International Foundation for Electoral Systems election guide covering election calendars, results, candidates, electoral systems, parties, legal frameworks, and country profiles.

name: ParlGov Database
notes: Comparative data on elections, cabinets, parties, leaders, legislative elections, coalition governments, and party positions in democracies.

name: Global Database of Events Language and Tone GDELT
notes: Global near-real-time news-derived events, entities, themes, locations, languages, imagery, and tone data; useful for discovery and trend analysis, not direct ground truth.

name: Global Database of Elections and Democracy V-Dem Regimes of the World
notes: V-Dem-derived regime classifications and democratic indicators, useful for longitudinal comparison of democracy, electoral autocracy, liberal democracy, and autocratization.

name: Open Government Partnership National Action Plans
notes: Country commitments, implementation assessments, civic participation, access-to-information, open-data, anti-corruption, and government-transparency reform records.

name: World Justice Project Rule of Law Index
notes: Annual comparative rule-of-law measures covering constraints on government, absence of corruption, open government, rights, order and security, regulatory enforcement, civil justice, and criminal justice.

name: Transparency International Corruption Perceptions Index
notes: Annual perception-based corruption index; useful for broad comparative signaling but should not substitute for case-level corruption evidence.

name: Open Budget Survey
notes: Comparative public-budget transparency, participation, oversight, audit, legislature, and fiscal-accountability assessments.

name: Global Right to Information Rating
notes: Comparative legal scoring of access-to-information laws, appeals, exemptions, proactive disclosure, enforcement, and institutional guarantees.

name: World Press Freedom Index
notes: Annual country ranking and qualitative assessment of media freedom, journalist safety, political context, legal framework, economic pressures, and infrastructure.

name: Varieties of Democracy Digital Society Project
notes: Expert-coded global data on online censorship, disinformation, social media, surveillance, internet shutdowns, digital media, and political manipulation.

name: Armed Conflict Location and Event Data Project ACLED
notes: Near-real-time structured data on political violence, protests, armed actors, locations, dates, fatalities, event types, and conflict trends. ACLED covers Africa, South and Southeast Asia, MENA, Central Asia/Caucasus, and Eastern/Southeastern Europe. [213][214]

name: Uppsala Conflict Data Program UCDP
notes: Free CC BY datasets on state-based conflict, non-state conflict, one-sided violence, battle deaths, external support, peace agreements, conflict termination, and georeferenced events. [205]

name: UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset GED
notes: Structured event-level data on organized violence, locations, actors, fatalities, dates, conflict dyads, and spatial patterns; generally more conservative than ACLED in coding thresholds.

name: UCDP One-sided Violence Dataset
notes: Cross-national dataset on intentional killing of civilians by governments and formally organized nonstate actors.

name: Global Terrorism Database START GTD
notes: START’s structured terrorism incident database, covering perpetrators, targets, tactics, weapons, casualties, locations, and context; historical coverage and coding rules vary by period.

name: International Terrorism: Attributes of Terrorist Events ITERATE
notes: Commercial structured dataset on transnational terrorist incidents, attacks, groups, targets, tactics, casualties, and international terrorism patterns.

name: Correlates of War COW Project
notes: Foundational international-relations datasets on interstate wars, militarized disputes, alliances, trade, national material capabilities, diplomatic exchange, territorial claims, and state-system membership.

name: COW National Material Capabilities Dataset
notes: Long-run annual data on military expenditure, personnel, iron and steel, energy, population, and composite national capability measures.

name: SIPRI Military Expenditure Database
notes: Annual defense spending estimates by country, constant and current prices, GDP and government-expenditure shares, with notes on sources and uncertainty.

name: SIPRI Multilateral Peace Operations Database
notes: Structured data on peace operations, mandates, personnel, locations, participants, budgets, casualties, and mission characteristics.

name: Global Terrorism Index
notes: Institute for Economics and Peace annual terrorism-impact rankings and country profiles; use alongside START GTD and event data rather than as a standalone operational dataset.

name: Global Peace Index
notes: Institute for Economics and Peace comparative index of societal safety, domestic and international conflict, militarization, and peace indicators.

name: Small Arms Survey Armed Violence Dataset
notes: Research, datasets, and analysis on small arms, armed violence, weapons flows, conflict, security, homicide, insurgency, and illicit firearms.

name: Global Firearms Holdings Database
notes: Cross-national estimates of civilian firearms holdings, state stockpiles, ownership patterns, and weapons prevalence; estimates carry uncertainty.

name: PRIO-GRID
notes: Spatiotemporal global grid with socioeconomic, environmental, political, demographic, and geographic covariates for conflict and security research. [206]

name: GEO-SVAC
source_type: Global sexual violence in conflict dataset
notes: PRIO/UCDP-related geocoded information on reported conflict-related sexual violence and armed actors’ use of sexual violence. [206]

name: Global Terrorism and Political Violence Map GDELT
notes: Near-real-time media-derived event and narrative data useful for alerting, trend analysis, entity mapping, and discovery; not direct incident confirmation.

name: International Crisis Group CrisisWatch
notes: Monthly global conflict tracker with country-level updates, risk assessments, diplomatic developments, armed actors, escalation indicators, and concise analyst interpretation.

name: Armed Conflict Survey IISS
notes: High-quality annual conflict analysis, armed actor profiles, regional strategic trends, and security assessments; publication access is commercial.

name: Fragile States Index
notes: Annual comparative indicators of cohesion, economic, political, social, security, demographic, refugee, elite, and state legitimacy pressures.

name: Global Organized Crime Index
notes: Global assessment of criminal markets, criminal actors, resilience, state capacity, organized-crime governance, and illicit-economy exposure.

name: Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime Observatory of Illicit Economies
notes: High-value data and analysis on illicit markets, organized crime, armed groups, trafficking, maritime crime, environmental crime, criminal governance, and resilience.

name: Arms Trade Treaty ATT Monitor
notes: Tracks Arms Trade Treaty implementation, national reports, transfer controls, diversion risks, transparency, arms-export policy, and compliance.

name: Global Database of Events Language and Tone GDELT 2.1
notes: See GDELT entry; retain one consolidated row unless separating event records from text, television, image, and translation monitoring.

name: UN OCHA Financial Tracking Service FTS
notes: Near-real-time humanitarian funding flows, donors, recipients, appeals, requirements, allocations, sectors, and emergency financing.

name: UNHCR Refugee Data Finder
notes: Global refugee, asylum seeker, stateless, internally displaced, resettlement, origin, host-country, and protection statistics.

name: Internal Displacement Monitoring Centre IDMC
notes: Global disaster- and conflict-related internal displacement figures, trends, country profiles, drivers, risk, and event analysis.

name: International Organization for Migration Displacement Tracking Matrix DTM
notes: Operational mobility, displacement, migration flows, locations, needs, routes, camps, arrivals, and crisis-response data.

name: WHO Global Health Observatory
notes: Global health indicators on disease, mortality, health systems, vaccination, risk factors, reproductive health, pandemics, financing, and SDGs.

name: WHO Disease Outbreak News
notes: Near-real-time official reports on significant disease outbreaks, public-health emergencies, pathogens, locations, response measures, and risk assessment.

name: Global Health Security Index
notes: Comparative assessment of prevention, detection, response, health system, norms, risk environment, and health-security capabilities; model and indicator assumptions should be reviewed.

name: Our World in Data
notes: Highly accessible curated global data and visualizations on health, economy, poverty, conflict, energy, climate, education, population, democracy, technology, and development, with source links and downloadable data.

name: UNdata
notes: UN statistical portal aggregating roughly 60 million records across UN agencies, including migration, refugees, development assistance, demographics, trade, and social indicators. [203]

name: UN DESA World Population Prospects
notes: Global demographic estimates and projections for population, fertility, mortality, age structure, migration, dependency, and demographic change.

name: UNICEF Data Warehouse
notes: Global child health, education, nutrition, protection, gender, WASH, poverty, displacement, and youth data.

name: WorldPop
notes: High-resolution gridded population, demographics, settlement, urbanization, age, sex, poverty, and health-related geospatial data.

name: Armed Conflict and Location Event Data ACLED
notes: See ACLED security entry; cross-list it under humanitarian work when modeling displacement, food insecurity, protection risk, and crisis response.

name: EM-DAT International Disaster Database
notes: Global disaster events, deaths, people affected, economic damage, disaster types, locations, timing, and historical disaster trends.

name: DesInventar Sendai
notes: UNDRR-supported disaster loss and damage data, including localized events, deaths, housing, infrastructure, livelihoods, and hazard impacts.

name: UNEP World Environment Situation Room
notes: Global environmental indicators, air, water, biodiversity, land, climate, ecosystems, pollution, resource use, and sustainability data.

name: World Resources Institute Climate Watch
notes: Global greenhouse-gas emissions, NDCs, climate targets, historical emissions, energy, land use, climate policy, and country climate-action data.

name: Global Carbon Project
notes: Global carbon budgets, fossil emissions, land-use change, sinks, atmospheric concentration, national emissions, and climate trends.

name: EDGAR Emissions Database
notes: Global anthropogenic emissions by country, sector, gas, source, and time period; suitable for emissions inventories and comparative analysis.

name: Climate TRACE
notes: Near-real-time and facility-level emissions estimates using satellites, remote sensing, machine learning, and other open data; estimates should be compared with official inventories.

name: Global Forest Watch
notes: Near-real-time forest cover loss, fires, concessions, protected areas, land use, commodity risk, biodiversity, and deforestation alerts using satellite data.

name: FAO Global Forest Resources Assessment FRA
notes: Periodic country-reported forest area, change, biodiversity, management, ownership, protection, carbon, and forestry data.

name: UN Biodiversity Lab
notes: Global geospatial datasets on biodiversity, protected areas, ecosystem services, climate, land use, species, and conservation planning.

name: Aqueduct Water Risk Atlas
notes: Global water stress, drought, flood, baseline water risk, aquifers, water quality, climate risk, and watershed indicators.

name: Global Landslide Catalog NASA
notes: Global landslide events and rainfall triggers, using media reports and satellite/rainfall data; useful for hazard monitoring with known reporting bias.

name: NOAA Global Historical Climatology Network
notes: Global weather-station observations, temperature, precipitation, climate normals, extreme events, and historical meteorological records.

name: Copernicus Climate Change Service ERA5
notes: Global hourly climate reanalysis, temperature, wind, precipitation, pressure, ocean, land, and atmospheric variables; technically demanding to use.

name: NASA FIRMS Fire Information for Resource Management System
notes: Near-real-time satellite active-fire and thermal anomaly data for wildfire, agriculture burning, conflict-related fires, industrial events, and environmental monitoring.

name: ITU Global Cybersecurity Index
notes: Comparative country assessment of cybersecurity legal, technical, organizational, capacity-development, and international-cooperation measures.

name: National Cyber Security Index
notes: Continuously updated country-level indicators of cybersecurity capacity, digital-service protection, incident response, policy, resilience, and public information.

name: Freedom on the Net
notes: Annual country assessments of internet access, censorship, surveillance, online rights, digital repression, platform control, and online political environment.

name: Access Now KeepItOn Shutdown Tracker
notes: Near-real-time and historical tracking of internet shutdowns, social media blocking, network restrictions, state disruptions, and digital rights incidents.

name: OONI Explorer
notes: Open measurement data on website blocking, DNS tampering, HTTP interference, app blocking, network performance, censorship, and online access restrictions.

name: Citizen Lab Research
notes: World-leading technical investigations of spyware, surveillance, censorship, digital forensics, transnational repression, platform security, and information operations.

name: Privacy International Data Exploitation Tracker
notes: Global research on surveillance, data exploitation, commercial spyware, biometric systems, policing technology, intelligence, and digital rights.

name: Global AI Index
notes: Comparative assessment of national AI investment, innovation, implementation, talent, infrastructure, operating environment, and strategy; proprietary methodology and access limitations apply.

name: AI Index Report Dataset
notes: Stanford Institute for Human-Centered AI global indicators on AI research, models, investment, compute, labor, policy, ethics, incidents, patents, and performance.

name: OECD AI Policy Observatory
notes: Global country policy data, AI strategies, incidents, research, talent, investment, regulation, governance, and AI policy instruments.

name: AI Incident Database
notes: Open database of reported AI incidents, harms, failures, safety events, discrimination, surveillance, misinformation, and misuse; reporting coverage is uneven.

name: Stanford Cyber Policy Center Cyber Incident Data
notes: Research datasets and analysis on cyber incidents, state behavior, cyber policy, influence operations, cyber norms, and national cybersecurity.

name: MIT Technology Review AI Policy and Compute Tracker
notes: Useful current-analysis source for AI policy, semiconductors, compute, regulation, technology competition, and industrial strategy; not a standardized quantitative dataset.

name: Google Open Buildings
notes: Global machine-learning-derived building footprints useful for settlement mapping, damage assessment, population estimates, infrastructure, and humanitarian analysis.

name: Microsoft Building Footprints
notes: Machine-learning-derived building footprint data for multiple countries, useful for urban analysis, settlement mapping, infrastructure, and disaster response.

name: OpenAQ
notes: Global open air-quality measurements aggregated from governments, research networks, and other sources, including PM2.5, PM10, ozone, nitrogen dioxide, and sulfur dioxide.

name: OpenCelliD
notes: Crowdsourced global cell-tower and cellular infrastructure database, useful for communications mapping and OSINT leads; validate coverage and accuracy locally.

name: Automatic Identification System AIS Data via Global Fishing Watch
notes: Use Global Fishing Watch’s public vessel and activity layer for accessible maritime OSINT; AIS is incomplete and susceptible to spoofing, manipulation, and gaps.

name: UNCTAD Review of Maritime Transport Data
notes: Global shipping, fleet, port, freight, container, maritime trade, chokepoint, ownership, flag, and transport statistics.

name: IMB Piracy Reporting Centre
notes: Near-real-time and historical piracy, armed robbery at sea, vessel, location, incident, and maritime security reporting; some detail is restricted.

name: MarineTraffic
notes: Commercial AIS-based vessel tracking, port calls, vessel profiles, ownership-related data, and maritime movement intelligence; use raw signals cautiously.

name: USGS EarthExplorer
notes: Primary access point for Landsat, aerial imagery, elevation, radar, historical satellite imagery, and geospatial datasets; requires analytical processing.

name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
notes: European Earth-observation data, including Sentinel optical, radar, atmospheric, marine, land, climate, and emergency-monitoring products.

name: Planet Disaster Data Program
notes: Commercial high-frequency satellite imagery for disaster, conflict, infrastructure, environmental, and humanitarian analysis; access is typically restricted or partner-based.

name: Sentinel Hub EO Browser
notes: Accessible interface for Sentinel, Landsat, MODIS, DEM, and other satellite imagery, useful for visual OSINT, change detection, fires, vegetation, and infrastructure analysis.

name: Bellingcat
notes: World-leading open-source investigations using imagery, geolocation, documents, social media, data, and digital forensics across conflict, corruption, state violence, extremism, aviation, and sanctions.

name: Forensic Architecture
notes: Advanced spatial, visual, architectural, satellite, audio, legal, and open-source investigations of state violence, conflict, borders, environmental harm, and human rights.

name: OpenFacto
notes: Open-source investigations of weapons, conflict, military supply chains, sanctions, maritime activity, authoritarianism, and corporate/state networks.

name: Oryx
notes: Visually confirmed military equipment-loss tracking, particularly valuable for Russia-Ukraine and other conflicts; rigorous evidence requirement makes totals an undercount.

name: Live Universal Awareness Map Liveuamap
notes: Near-real-time map aggregating conflict, protest, security, and emergency reports; useful for alerts and discovery, requiring source-level verification.

name: Open Source Munitions Portal Oryx Archive
notes: Use Oryx’s documented visual databases and archive pages rather than duplicate source entries for each campaign, theater, or equipment type.

name: Political Terror Scale
notes: Annual country-level coding of state terror, political imprisonment, torture, extrajudicial killing, disappearance, and repression based on human-rights reports.

name: CIRI Human Rights Data Project Archive
notes: Historical annual data on government respect for internationally recognized rights, covering roughly 200 countries through 2011; archival, not current.

name: Human Rights Measurement Initiative HRMI
notes: Comparative data on civil, political, economic, social, and cultural rights, including expert surveys, income-adjusted benchmarks, and rights conditions.

name: CIVICUS Monitor
notes: Near-current country assessments of civic space, protest, association, assembly, speech, civil society, digital rights, and repression.

name: Global Database on Violence Against Women
notes: UN Women legal, policy, prevalence, institutional, and country information on violence against women and gender-based violence.

name: Walk Free Global Slavery Index
notes: Cross-country estimates and analysis of forced labor, forced marriage, modern slavery, vulnerability, government response, and supply-chain risk; modeled estimates should be treated cautiously.

name: Minorities at Risk MAR Project
notes: Historical comparative data on politically active ethnic groups, discrimination, mobilization, protest, rebellion, autonomy, and state-group relations.

name: Ethnic Power Relations EPR Dataset
notes: Global data on ethnic groups’ access to executive power, exclusion, autonomy, political status, conflict, and state-group relations.

name: OpenAlex
notes: Open global scholarly graph of works, authors, institutions, concepts, citations, funders, and publication metadata, useful for research mapping and technology analysis.

name: Crossref Metadata API
notes: Global DOI-linked publication metadata, publishers, citations, funders, licenses, dates, and scholarly records.

name: OpenSanctions Research Data
notes: See security entry; useful also for academic research on sanctions, elite networks, companies, political exposure, and illicit finance.

name: PRIO Data
notes: Repository of PRIO datasets and replication material, including corruption, peacebuilding, conflict, geospatial, sexual violence, armed groups, and peace organization data. [206]

name: Harvard Dataverse
notes: Large open repository for academic datasets, code, replication packages, social science, conflict, political, economic, health, and humanitarian research; vet dataset-specific methods.

name: World Bank Microdata Library
notes: Household, enterprise, labor, health, education, poverty, agriculture, social, and development survey microdata from the World Bank and partners.

name: International Relations Data Program ICPSR
notes: Major social-science data repository with political, economic, public opinion, conflict, health, demographic, governance, and survey datasets; some materials require institutional access.
